with_social.description: Modo completo CON intención + target — mismas reglas que el compacto, con claves largas y el mapeo caja→clave explícito. Usa {ctx}/{n_people}/{motion_hint}/{mapping}/{keys}/{slots}.
with_social.template:
Context: {ctx} ({n_people} people with ID<number> boxes).
{motion_hint}Mapping (Box Label -> Key):
{mapping}

Generate JSON for keys [{keys}] using schema {{{slots}}}:
1. 'action': the action the person is doing, in a few words.
2. 'social': their intention, EXACTLY one of these 5 words: ATTENTIVE, AVAILABLE, BUSY, ENGAGED, MOVING.
   - ATTENTIVE: looking at the camera/robot and seems to want to interact.
   - AVAILABLE: free, not focused on anything, fine to approach.
   - BUSY: focused on a solo task (phone, reading, working, eating...) or back turned to the camera.
   - ENGAGED: talking or interacting with another person.
   - MOVING: walking or changing position.
3. 'target': the key of the person the robot should approach to start an interaction. If at least one person is ATTENTIVE or AVAILABLE, 'target' MUST be one of them (ATTENTIVE first, then AVAILABLE, then the closest); use null ONLY if every person is BUSY, ENGAGED or MOVING.

Output ONLY raw JSON.

no_social.description: Modo completo SIN estado social — solo descripción de acción. Usa {ctx}/{n_people}/{motion_hint}/{mapping}/{keys}/{slots}.
no_social.template:
Context: {ctx} ({n_people} people with purple ID<number> boxes).
{motion_hint}Mapping:
{mapping}

Describe action for keys [{keys}] in 1-3 words.
Output ONLY raw JSON format: {{{slots}}}.

motion_hint.description: Nota anti-sesgo para clips de video (solo modo full): no juzgar 'walking' desde un solo frame estático.
motion_hint.template: Note: Track gait across clip. Do not label walking as standing from a single static frame.
